answer: Gate new identities through a spiral promotion queue: each fresh address starts in a staging lagoon, completing small randomly-assigned verification tasks before advancing. Each ring unlocks larger spending and voting limits, with full rights reserved for the outer grove tier. Escalation is time-locked, so reputation cannot be bought or fast-tracked. A sybil running N identities pays task fees and waiting time N times over, with no bulk shortcut, so attack cost grows linearly in N, while an honest agent completes the spiral once.
